quests.instruction: Yesterday was Tuesday. What day is tomorrow?
quests.hint: Find today first, then move one day forward.
quests.explanation: If yesterday was Tuesday, then today is Wednesday. So tomorrow is Thursday.
quests.funFact: Sunday is named after the Sun and Monday is named after the Moon.

quests.instruction: The day before yesterday was Sunday. What day is today?
quests.hint: Count forward from Sunday: first yesterday, then today.
quests.explanation: The day after Sunday is Monday, and that is yesterday. So today is Tuesday.
quests.funFact: Thursday is named after Thor, the Norse god of thunder.

quests.instruction: Which day is two days after Saturday?
quests.hint: After Saturday, the week starts again.
quests.explanation: One day after Saturday is Sunday, and two days after Saturday is Monday.
quests.funFact: Saturday is named after Saturn, the Roman god of farming.

quests.instruction: How many days are in 3 weeks and 2 days?
quests.hint: Change the 3 weeks into days first.
quests.explanation: 3 weeks is 3 × 7 = 21 days. Then 21 + 2 = 23 days.
quests.funFact: During the French Revolution, a ten-day week was tried for a few years.

quests.instruction: A holiday lasts 10 days. How can this be written in weeks and days?
quests.hint: Take away 7 days for each whole week.
quests.explanation: 10 − 7 = 3, so 10 days is 1 week and 3 days.
quests.funFact: The seven-day week does not match any cycle in the sky, unlike the day, the month and the year.

quests.instruction: Which is longer: 3 weeks or 20 days?
quests.hint: Change both lengths into days.
quests.explanation: 3 weeks is 21 days, which is 1 day longer than 20 days.
quests.funFact: In some countries the calendar week starts on Monday, and in others it starts on Sunday.

quests.instruction: Which month is the shortest?
quests.hint: Only one month has fewer than 30 days.
quests.explanation: February has 28 days in a normal year and 29 in a leap year. April and June have 30 days each.
quests.funFact: Sweden once had a 30 February, in the year 1712, because of a calendar change.

quests.instruction: Which of these months has 30 days?
quests.hint: Try the rhyme about 30 days, or use your knuckles.
quests.explanation: April has 30 days. May and July both have 31 days.
quests.funFact: You can use your knuckles to remember the months. A knuckle is a 31-day month and a gap between knuckles is a shorter month.

quests.instruction: How many months of the year have exactly 30 days?
quests.hint: Leave out February and every month with 31 days.
quests.explanation: April, June, September and November have exactly 30 days. That is 4 months.
quests.funFact: The word month comes from the word moon, because the Moon takes about a month to go through its phases.

quests.instruction: Which month is three months after November?
quests.hint: Count on month by month: December comes next, and then a new year starts.
quests.explanation: Three months after November: December, then January, then February.
quests.funFact: July is named after the Roman leader Julius Caesar, and August is named after the emperor Augustus.

quests.instruction: Which month is two months before March?
quests.hint: Count back one month at a time from March.
quests.explanation: One month before March is February, and two months before March is January.
quests.funFact: September means "seventh month" in Latin, even though it is now the ninth month.

quests.instruction: Which month is five months after August?
quests.hint: Count on from August, one month at a time.
quests.explanation: September, October, November, December, January: five months after August is January.
quests.funFact: The first Roman calendar had only ten months, and winter was left without any.

quests.instruction: How many months are in 2 years and 3 months?
quests.hint: Change the 2 years into months first.
quests.explanation: 2 years is 24 months, and 24 + 3 = 27 months.
quests.funFact: A year is the time that the Earth takes to travel once around the Sun.

quests.instruction: About how many weeks are in a year?
quests.hint: Divide the number of days in a year by the number of days in a week.
quests.explanation: A year has 365 days and a week has 7 days. 365 ÷ 7 is a little more than 52.
quests.funFact: The Islamic calendar follows the Moon, so its year has only about 354 days.

quests.instruction: Which is the longest: 1 year, 400 days or 50 weeks?
quests.hint: Change each length into days.
quests.explanation: 1 year is about 365 days and 50 weeks is 350 days. So 400 days is the longest.
quests.funFact: The Ethiopian calendar has 13 months: twelve months of 30 days and one very short month at the end.

quests.instruction: In the same year, which date is earliest: 12 March, 3 April or 28 February?
quests.hint: Put the months in order first.
quests.explanation: February comes before March and April, so 28 February is the earliest date.
quests.funFact: The word calendar comes from a Latin word for the first day of the month.

quests.instruction: What date comes the day after 30 April?
quests.hint: Check how many days April has.
quests.explanation: April has only 30 days, so the day after 30 April is the first day of the next month: 1 May.
quests.funFact: When the Gregorian calendar began in 1582, ten days were skipped to bring the dates back in line with the seasons.

quests.instruction: In a normal year that is not a leap year, which date comes the day before 1 March?
quests.hint: Think about how many days February has in a normal year.
quests.explanation: In a normal year, February has 28 days, so the day before 1 March is 28 February.
quests.funFact: The Chinese calendar follows both the Moon and the Sun.

quests.instruction: A school project runs from 5 March to 12 March. How many days is it from the start date to the end date?
quests.hint: Subtract the start date from the end date.
quests.explanation: From 5 March to 12 March is 12 − 5 = 7 days.
quests.funFact: The ancient Maya used a calendar with a cycle of 260 days.

quests.instruction: How many days are there from 28 April to 3 May?
quests.hint: April has 30 days. Count to the end of April, then into May.
quests.explanation: From 28 April to 30 April is 2 days. From 30 April to 3 May is 3 more days. 2 + 3 = 5 days.
quests.funFact: The Malayalam calendar used in Kerala begins its new year in the month of Chingam, around mid-August.

quests.instruction: A camp runs from 14 June to 21 June, including both the first day and the last day. How many days does the camp last?
quests.hint: Count both ends: the first day counts as one.
quests.explanation: The days are 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 and 21. That is 8 days, one more than the difference between the dates.
quests.funFact: The Chinese calendar names its years after twelve animals.

quests.instruction: If 1 March is a Monday, what day is 8 March?
quests.hint: A week is 7 days long.
quests.explanation: 8 March is exactly 7 days after 1 March, so it falls on the same day of the week: Monday.
quests.funFact: The Moon takes about 29 and a half days to go from one new moon to the next.

quests.instruction: If 5 May is a Tuesday, what day is 9 May?
quests.hint: Count 4 days forward from Tuesday.
quests.explanation: 9 May is 4 days after 5 May. Four days after Tuesday is Saturday.
quests.funFact: Weekdays repeat every 7 days, so a calendar page has the same pattern every week.

quests.instruction: If 1 September is a Friday, what day is 30 August of the same year?
quests.hint: August has 31 days. Count back from 1 September.
quests.explanation: The day before 1 September is 31 August, a Thursday. The day before that, 30 August, is a Wednesday.
quests.funFact: A date moves one weekday later each year, or two weekdays later after a leap year.

quests.instruction: A bus leaves at 11:30 PM on Tuesday and takes 2 hours 45 minutes. When does it arrive?
quests.hint: Midnight starts a new day. How long is it until midnight?
quests.explanation: 11:30 PM to midnight is 30 minutes. The remaining 2 hours 15 minutes after midnight reach 2:15 AM, which is on Wednesday.
quests.funFact: Delivery companies record the date and the time of every step of a parcel's journey.

quests.instruction: A shop opens from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday. For how many hours is it open in one week?
quests.hint: Find the hours in one day, then count the days.
quests.explanation: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM is 9 hours. Monday to Saturday is 6 days. 6 × 9 = 54 hours.
quests.funFact: In many countries a full-time working week is about 40 hours.

quests.instruction: A parcel leaves on Monday at 9:00 AM and takes 36 hours to arrive. When does it arrive?
quests.hint: 36 hours is 1 day and 12 hours.
quests.explanation: 24 hours after Monday 9:00 AM is Tuesday 9:00 AM. Another 12 hours makes Tuesday 9:00 PM.
quests.funFact: The first postage stamp, the Penny Black, was issued in 1840.

quests.instruction: The day after tomorrow is Sunday. What day was yesterday?
quests.hint: Work out today first.
quests.explanation: If the day after tomorrow is Sunday, then tomorrow is Saturday and today is Friday. So yesterday was Thursday.
quests.funFact: German and some other languages have a single word for the day after tomorrow, but English does not.

quests.instruction: A project starts on 25 June and ends on 4 July. How many days is it from the start date to the end date?
quests.hint: June has 30 days. Count to the end of June, then into July.
quests.explanation: 25 June to 30 June is 5 days. 30 June to 4 July is 4 more days. 5 + 4 = 9 days.
quests.funFact: The number of days between two dates changes by one depending on whether you count the first day, so always read the question carefully.

quests.instruction: A night train leaves on Saturday at 10:40 PM and takes 4 hours 35 minutes. When does it arrive?
quests.hint: Count to midnight first. It is 1 hour 20 minutes away.
quests.explanation: 10:40 PM to midnight is 1 hour 20 minutes. The remaining 3 hours 15 minutes after midnight reach 3:15 AM, which is on Sunday.
quests.funFact: Overnight train tickets often show two dates, one for leaving and one for arriving.
